notes.title: Release Announcement
notes.notes: Alien Cafe is finally here! That's right, the game is released, and now playable. This means it has just entered its early release stages, and will have many bugs and problems. If you find any, report them here, and they will be fixed with the next major update.

notes.title: Q&A Board
notes.notes: This is a Q&A board for Alien Cafe. Here you can ask any questions you may have regarding the game, or leave any suggestions you want to see in future updates.
